title: Machines for host phases
statement: Given Boolean-alphabet machines $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$, define for each host phase a multi-tape machine with the state space assigned to that phase and with $3+2k_V+2k_I+2k_P+1$ work tapes. The phase machines perform, respectively, cleanup setup, origin marking, counter copying, incrementing, rewinding, the counter loop running the body machine, a final test, or the answer procedure; the designated tape embeddings and the Boolean answer parameter are those specified by the corresponding phase.
